ftb.guhs_techniek.q.centrale_knuffel.des: The &dMega Cuddle Plant&r is a giant 5 by 3 cushion. Up to &d16 tamed guhs&r come and cuddle on it by themselves, and every guh gives &b22 vadskracht&r: 352 together! Do look after them: &6food&r (kaasknabbels, pink buns or blocks of kaasknabbels) and &6one wool&r a day for fresh blankets. One per net.
ftb.guhs_techniek.q.centrale_export.desc: The &dguh villagers&r (Vadsmonteur, Miner, Crystal Cutter and Magic Guh) buy &6bulk&r from your factories every day: blocks of kaasknabbels, knuffelsteen, coloured wool and baked goods. They pay with rare things: clothes, plushies, weather jars, dream sand and even fossils. New orders every day!
